tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dbul sel nam mkha'i bang mdzod gter gyi snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dbul sel nam mkha' bang mdzod gter gyi snye ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// ser sna dang ni 'jur gegs kyi// las kyis 'phangs pa'i lus can rnams// ngal ba de las skyob byed pa// dbul sel nor bu bdag gis bshad// sgrub pa po gang zhig 'di'i dbang lung thob cing ser sna dang sdug gsog gi bsam pa mi mnga' bas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa dag rdzogs byang thob pa'i rgyu thog mar dgos pa ni/ dbu ma 'jug pa las// skye bo 'di dag bde ba mngon 'dod cing*// mi rnams bde ba'ang longs spyod med min la// longs spyod kyang ni sbyin las 'byung mkhyen nas// thub pas dang po sbyin pa'i gtam mdzad do// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa'i gtam phun sum tshogs pa dag ni/ rnyed brtson sogs zong zogs gyi na ba dag min pa dang dngos grub phra mo 'byung ba'i phyir du/ dzaṃ bha la rigs bzhi'i bsgrub pa ni/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo/ */dang po sngon 'gro ni/ 'di'i dbang bskur thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dam tshig gtsang zhing so thar ris bdun gang rung gi sdom pa la gnas pas/ dbul po la sbyin pa gtong zhing yi dwags la chu sbyin mang du bya zhing*/ gzhan yang ser sna'i las sgrib sbyong thabs len dang rnam par smin pa la mi re zhing gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin mang du bya/ sātstsha gdab cing dkon mchog mchod pa la 'bad par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi ste/ phyi sgrub mchod sbyin la brten pa/ nang sgrub gtor ma la brten pa/ gsang sgrub ga'u la brten pa/ yang gsang tsitta nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la brten pa dang bzhi'o/ */dang po ni/ gser dngul zangs sogs rin po che'i snod du dzi tang ran pa gas chag dang nag nog med pa legs par phyis pa sa rdo ma yin pa'i stegs bu sor bzhi las mi dma' ba'i steng du bzhag */rin po che'i snod du chu gtsang 'o ma dri bzang tsandan dmar po dang*/ gur gum/ li khri/ sindhu ra/

ug chos/ lug ru dmar po sogs kyis sbags pa'i chu nyer bsdogs byas la rang nyid stan bde bar kha nub tu phyogs pas 'dug la/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas rang yi dam gang rung gsal gdab/ sems can thams cad dbul phong gi 'jigs pa las sgrol zhing gtan pa med pa'i sbyin pa rgya chen pos tshim par bya ba'i slad du dbul sel nam mkha'i bang mdzod gter gyi snye ma la 'bad par bya'o nyams pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba dang ge sar so so'i dbus su a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du baṃ yig las 'bras kyi snye ma baṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros/ sems can thams cad dbul zhing phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral zhing ser sna'i las kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma zhi zhing 'dzum la/ 'jo sgeg rol ba'i lang tsho gsar pa brgyad gnyis lon pa lta bu phyag g.yas shing thog gi bi dza pū ra ka dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon 'bras dkar gyi snye ma gsar pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ rin po che'i cod pan sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mthon mthing ral pa'i lan bu phyed bcings kyis rgyab tu grol ba/ lha rdzas kyi reg bya du mas stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs lhab lhub tu bgyis pa/ me tog rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phreng ba gsar pas legs par brgyan pa/ lus med rnam par bde ba'i nyams can bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gyings pa/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed pas rin po che 'bar ba skyugs pa'i padma'i gter rnams mnan pa/ de dag gi mdun dang g.yas su zla gdan/ rgyab dang g.yon du nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ mdun nas g.yas skor gyi dzaṃ yig dkar ser dmar nag 'od 'bar ba re re gsal ba rnams las 'od zer 'phros/

don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las// mdun du dzaṃ bha la sku mdog dung gi ri dbang lta bu 'brug la tsan 'khyil du zhon pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin cing dar dang rin po che du mas brgyan pa/ g.yas su dzaṃ bha la 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi mdog can/ g.yas shing thog bi dza pū ra ka g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin pa/ utpa la'i phreng ba can zhabs kyis padma'i gdong dang gter bdag mnan pa| rgyab tu dzaṃ bha la sku mdog padma rā ga'i mdog can zhal gsum phyag drug /zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ dbus sku dang mthun pa zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ phyag drug g.yas dang pos rin po che/ bar pas lcags kyu/ g.yon dang pos thod pa nor bus gang ba/ bar pas zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis ne'u le nor gyis gang ba re re 'dzin pa/ zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gyis gnod sbyin nor skyug gnyis mnan pa/ chags pa'i nyams can/ dar dang rin po che du mas brgyan pa'i thugs kar lha mo ku ru kulle dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ g.yon du 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin sku mdog ind+ra nī la'i lhun po la dus kyi mun pas 'khyud pa lta bu/ g.yas thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu mi'u thung gi gzugs can zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i brkyang bskum gyis nor bdag ser po mnan pa/ de ltar gtso 'khor lha'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa lta bu'i ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs rje can// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// dam tshig dbang gis 'dir gshegs shig /badzra sa mā dzaḥ

dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pa shapada'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso mo dang dzaṃ ser la rin 'byung*/ dkar po la rnam snang*/ dmar po la 'od dpag med/ nag po la mi bskyod pa'i cod pan gyis rgyas gdab ste dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim par mos/ de nas chu de nyid rang gi lag g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba'i dbus su a yig dkar pos mtshan pa las bdud rtsi ro brgya dang ldan pa lha'i 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi la yang nges par 'khu bar nus pa'i rgyun bab pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtso 'khor lnga'i zhal du phul zhing sku khrus gsol bas mnyes shing tshims nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad la nor gyi dngos grub char dbab pa ltar stsol zhing rgyas par gyur par dmigs nas/ g.yon mchog sbyin gyi drung du g.yas pas chu sbreng zhing*/ oṃ bā su dha ri ṇyai dzaṃ bha la dza lend+rā ya dzaṃ bha lend+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥ ind+ra ṇī mu kha bhra ma ri swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig gis chu phul te/ gong gi sngags mthar sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar arghaṃ nas shapada'i bar btags pas mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ lha mo gang gis yid la dran tsam gyis// phun tshogs rin chen nor dang 'bru rnams dang*// rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub ster mdzad ma// bsam 'phel nor rgyun gter la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhi ba'i tshul bzhin bcom ldan zla ba'i mdog /sgra sgrog steng na tsan 'khyil gyis rol zhing*// bgrang phreng gter gyi sre mong 'dzin phyag 'tshal// brtser dgongs dbul sel bdag gi re ba sgrubs// nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzaṃ bha la// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi lha// thugs rjes chags pas sku mdog dmar por bzhugs// dbang gi phrin las rdzogs mdzad dzaṃ bha la// phyag 'tshal 'gro ba'i re ba bskang du gsol// 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin chu dbang 'chol pa nag

/mi'u thung gzugs 'chang gnod sbyin sde dpon che// khyod ni mi bskyod mchog tu bdag dran gyi// phyag 'tshal nor gyi dngos grub myur du stsol// zhes bstod/ 'dod gsol ni/ ser sna'i las kyi me yis gdungs pa rnams// skye dang skye bar khyod la skyabs su mchi// rin chen bdud rtsi'i gter gyi char rgyun gyis// sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod// ces gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs// bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol bar bsam/ badzra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la bsdus la/ chu de nyid dngos grub kyi ched du rang gi bza' btung gi khu ba bya ba'am/ yang na khrus chu de nyid phyogs bcur dbul zhing phongs pa rnams la bdag gis nor sna tshogs kyi sbyin pa len dang rnam smin la mi re bas sbyin bsam la gtor ro// de lta bu'i tshul gyis dngos grub phran bu thob pa'i mtshan ma ma byung gi bar du 'bum sogs nges par bya dgos so/// / ༈ /gnyis pa nang sgrub gtor ma la brten pa ni/ zangs gzhong du sman 'bru rin po che sogs gtsang zhing legs pa'i phye ma la mar dkar gyis sbrus pa'i gtor ma padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du/ rin po che dbang gi rgyal po zur bzhi dbus kyi rtse mo dang lnga so'i dbyibs can 'phyar ba'i tshul dang*/ phyogs bzhir nor bu gsum re'i steng du nor bu zlum po rtse mo cung zad mtho ba re bzhag pa bzhis bskor ba'i bar mtshams dang mtha' skor du/ rin po che'i gzugs sna tshogs pas bskor ba rgyan gyis mdzes par byas pa de dag gi mdun du/ rin po che'i snod du mchod pa'i gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sbags pa dkar zhing zlum pa nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i dbyibs can dang rang 'dra ba'i 'khor bzhis bskor ba bshams/ de dag la zas sna 'bru sman shing thog la sogs mkho dgu'i bza' btung gis bran/

mchod pa sna tshogs pas bskor/ spyan gzigs mtha' yas pa legs par bkram la/ stan bde bar sgrub pa po kha nub tu phyogs pas skyabs sems sngon du 'gro zhing gtor ma sngar ltar gtso 'khor du bskyed pa ni/ bsang sbyang nas rgyas 'debs kyi bar sngar bshad ma thag pa ltar byas la mchod cing bstod nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ gtor ma'i lha gtso mo dang*/ dzaṃ lha dkar ser gyi thugs kar zla ba dang*/ dzaṃ bha la dmar nag gi thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa la phog /de las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas mchod cing sems can dbul phong gis nyen pa thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa la thim zhing*/ slar yang sngags bzlas pas lha rnams dgyes nas phyag gi ne'u le nor gyis gang ba de rnams btsir te sna tshogs pa'i rin po che skyug pas stong gsum gang bar byas/ slar yang lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las dgos 'dod sna tshogs pa'i nor bu dang*/ longs spyod dpal 'byor mkho dgu du ma byung bas bdag sogs sems can thams cad dbul zhing phongs pa nyes pa'i 'ching las grol bar mdzad bzhin par gyur par dmigs te/ oṃ bā su dha ri ṇyai dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra ya bā su dha ri ṇyai dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra ya dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra dha na me dhi hrīḥ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drā ya/ ma hā yakṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tadya thā/ dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra ya sarba bā su ratna siddhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes dri sna tshogs pa'i ril bu'i phreng ba'am/ tsandan dmar po'i phreng ba la bzlas brjod smra ba bcad nas ma yeng bar dngos grub thob pa'i mtshan ma ma byung ba'i bar du bya/ de dag gi thun mtshams rnams su mchod bstod 'dod gsol rnams chu sbyin gyi dus su bshad pa ltar bya'o// de ltar bsgrubs pas grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba'i tshe/

gtor ma de nyid dngos grub kyi tshul du rang nyid kyis rol ba'am mdzod phugs su sba bar bya zhing*/ mchod rdzas gzhan rnams dbang gi sbyin sreg dkyus gzhan nas bshad pa ltar bya'o/// / ༈ /gsum pa gsang sgrub ga'u la brten pa ni/ rin po che'i ga'u gru bzhi pa sor bzhi las mi chung ba'i ma gab kyi nang du dri bzang gi padma 'dab ma bzhi pa bris pa'i steng du lha rnams mngon rtogs lta bu'i rab 'bur sku dang*/ 'bring bris sku/ tha ma sngags la rten par gnas ma 'chol bar bkod pa'i bar rnams su zas sna/ 'bru sna/ nor sna/ sman sna/ rin po che sogs mkho dgu'i longs spyod dar zab la sogs pas gang bar byas pa'i ga'u de dag gi ya gab la 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa bris la dgab/ ga'u'i phyi la bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rdzas brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang nam mkha'i mdzod dang sa gzhi'i mdzod cha bdun la sogs pa bris la dar zab sna tshogs pas bsgril ba 'bras dkar gyi phung po'i steng du khri'u khar bzhag la/ de'i steng du gzung thag btags pa'i sne mor rang gis bzung*/ mchod pa'i gtor ma dang mchod rdzas sogs nang sgrub ltar bshams la ga'u lha sku zhal shar dang sgrub po kha nub tu phyogs pas 'khod/ sgrub pa ni/ ga'u lha so so'i chu sbyin gyi bsang sbyang nas rgyas 'debs kyi bar 'gres nas/ mchod bstod kyang gong ltar byas la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa nang ltar dngos grub tha ma'i nges pa brtan po lan gsum ma byung gi bar bsgrubs shing*/ thun mtshams su gtor sgrub tu bshad pa ltar byas pas bsgrub bo// de ltar bsgrubs nas nges pa thob pa'i tshe ga'u rang gi lus dang mi 'bral ba bcang zhing*/ mchod rdzas gzhan rnams sbyin sreg du dbul lo// yang na ga'u gzhan gyis mi mthong ba'i mdzod phugs su sba bar bya'o/// / ༈ /bzhi pa tsitta nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la brten pa/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus dang 'dab mar sngar bshad pa'i lha rnams bskyed pa sogs byas nas/

rang dang lha rnams kyi sku dbyer med pa chu nang du zla ba shar ba lta bu dang*/ rang dang lha'i gsung dbyer med 'brug gi sgra brag char grags pa ltar sngags bzla ba'i tshe lha rnams kyis kyang sngags bzla zhing*/ rang dang lha'i thugs dbyer med pa phyi rol gyi nam mkha' dang rkyen bug pa'i nam mkha' tha mi dad pa'i gsal stong du bsams la sngags bzla zhing*/ rdzogs rim ni nub kyi nam mkha'i dbyings su mig 'gul tshum spangs nas bsgrad de bltas pa'i tshe/ bdag dang nor rgyun ma gtso 'khor dang nam mkha'i khams tha dad med par rig pa gtad med nam mkha' dang bsres la ci yang yid la mi bya bar yun ring du bsgom/ slar yang gong ltar snying gi nang du sgom zhing bzlas pa dang mchod bstod la 'bad/ rang gi bza' btung gi tshe/ bza' btung 'dod pa'i longs spyod mkho dgur gyur pa rang gis za zhing btung ba'i tshe/ rang lhar gsal ba'i rtsa khams kyi lha dang lha mo rnams tshims par byas shing*/ khyad par nor lha gtso 'khor lnga shin tu dgyes shing nor rgyun ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon las dmar cha'i rang bzhin 'od zer dmar po padma rā ga'i khu ba lta bu dang*/ dzaṃ bha la bzhi'i thugs ka'i sa bon las dkar cha'i rang bzhin zla ba zhu ba ltar dpag tu med pa byung bas rang gi lus kyi phyi nang rtsa khams thams cad khrigs se mer gyis gang bas bde stong zag pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes rang rgyud la bskrun par byas/ slar yang sre mong nor bus gang ba rnams rab tu btsir te nor bu dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po dpag tu med pa skyug pas/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis kyang nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad dbul phongs kyi 'jigs pa las sgrol/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i skal pa can du byed bzhin par mos par bya'o// de ltar 'di ni lus dkyil rgyun 'khyer du bya ba'i tshul te rang ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du nyams su len pas na dus mtshams la nges pa med cing grub pa thob pa'i rtags dang yang sbyor mi dgos pas so// de ltar phyi sgrub mchod sbyin dang yang gsang tsitta nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gnyis ni mtshams bcad pa sogs bya mi dgos shing*/

nang sgrub gtor ma dang gsang sgrub gnyis la ni dben par mtshams dam par bya zhing grib la 'dzems/ ngag smra ba bcad/ lus dal zhing sems log 'khrul gyi rtog pa spong ba gal che ba dag go// gsum pa rjes ni/ de lta bu'i phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang dang bcas pa dbul sel gyi sgrub ba grub pa'i nges pa ma rnyed bar du 'bad pas bsgrubs nas nges pa brtan po rnyed pa'i tshe/ yang gsang tsitta nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la rgyun 'khyer ma chag par bya zhing*/ phyi sgrub chu sbyin yang snga dro'i dus tshar re nges par ma chag par bya/ nang sgrub gtor ma dang gsang sgrub ga'u gnyis ni lo dus kyi dbyar ra ston zla 'khrig khyim la bab pa'i dkar cha'i phyogs la sgrub pa lan re ma chag par bya zhing*// dam tshig la gzhan gyi longs spyod la phra dog spang ba dang*/ gzhan gyis sbyin pa gtong ba'am rang gis sbyin pa la ser sna dang khe grags re dogs spang la/ rang gis longs spyod cher rnyed nas chog shes pa dang*/ ma rnyed na 'tshol khrol dang ser sna'i sdug gsog spang*/ dus dang yun du rang gis ma byin pa len pa spang zhing*/ gzhan dag gis de byas pa la yi rang ba dang byed du mi gzhug /lhag par bud med kyi nor mi 'phrog /yug mo la mi reg pa dang*/ yug sa sgren mo'i lag gi bza' btung gos sogs mi spyod/ 'khrig pa'i chos spong zhing bud med kyi rigs la sdang zhing gshe bar mi byed/ tshod zin cing 'tshams pa ma gtogs pha rol bslu ba'i tshong zong spangs pa sogs la bslab/ sbyin pa'i las la 'bad cing*/ sgrub pa dang chu sbyin gyi dus sha chang sgog btsong dang log pa'i 'tsho ba ring du spang nas bag yod pa'i kha zas la bslab/ 'doms sogs ngo tsha ba'i gnas rnams rang nyid gcig pu'i dus su yang gos kyis sba ba gnad du che zhing*/ ngo tsha ba'i gnas kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi kun spyod thams cad mi bya/ mdor na mi dge ba'i phyogs bag med rtsab hral thams cad spang la/

dge ba'i phyogs bag dang ldan pa'i zhi dul bzang po'i ngang tshul la dus kun tu bslab/ 'di'i gzhung sgrub sngags dang gtor ma ga'u bris sku bzlas brjod sogs sbyor dngos mjug thams cad dbang ma thob pa'i gang zag dang*/ log lta can nam ser sna can sdug gsog mkhan rnams la shin tu gsang*/ dbang bskur ba dang sgrub yig gi lung dang lag len sbyin na'ang gzhan phan gyi sems mnga' zhing 'di sgrub nges pa la sbyin zhing*/ de'i tshe de dag la byin pa thag chod kyi tshul du sbyin pa che chung gang yang rung ba re re sbyin pa'i khas len byed du gzhug /rang 'dod khe grags ser sna'i sdug gsog mkhan longs spyod kyang rang nyid log 'tsho'i ched dam/ bag med log pa'i las mi dge ba'i phyogs la spyod par sems pa rnams la shin tu gsang bar bya ba rnams dam tshig yin/ de las 'gal nas lha 'grub par sems pa rnams nam mkha' la ljon shing skye bar re ba dang cha mtshungs pas go bar byos shig /thun mtshams rnams su mchod bstod kyi sngon du gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma lha rdzas las bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i khams khyab par gyur par dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ lha rnams kyi ljags 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bas mnyes shing tshims nas ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol bar gyur par bsam la/ sngags mjug tu i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes bdun gyis dbul bar bya'o/ /de rnams ni sgrub thams kyi rim pa'o/// / ༈ /slob ma phongs kyang las 'phro can rjes su 'dzin pa dbang gi cho ga ni/ gnas yid dang mthun pa'i stegs kyi khar rdul tshon phyogs mdog lte ba ge sar ser zhing gong ras mdzes tshon mu khyud ljang khu can gyi dbus su zla gdan gyi steng du 'bras kyi snye ma'i lte bar baṃ yig ser po/

shar du zla gdan gyi dbus su bgrang phreng gi lte bar dzaṃ dkar po/ lhor zla gdan gyi dbus su shing thog bi dza pū ra ka'i lte bar baṃ ser po/ nub tu nyi gdan gyi dbus su rin po che'i lte bar dzaṃ dmar po/ byang du nyi gdan gyi dbus su thod khrag gi nang dzaṃ nag po rnams lañtsa'am wartu las bris pa/ de'i shar du bum pa lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas kyis bkang ba mgul chings dang kha rgyan gyis spras pa/ lhor nang sgrub kyi gtor ma/ nub tu sngags bris pa'i yi ge tsaka li dang bgrang phreng*/ byang du gsang sgrub kyi ga'u de dag gi mthar bza' btung longs spyod sna tshogs pa'i dam rdzas dang ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa bsham mo// slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ las bum/ dam chu/ chu sbyin gyi snod rin po che'i gzhong pa sngar bshad pa'i chu/ rin po che'i snod du zas sna tshogs pa/ gzhan yang mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'du byas la bkod legs par bshams/ de nas bgegs la gtor ma sbyin la bka' bsgo/ slob dpon skyabs sems sngon du btang zhing yi dam gang rung gi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor chu sbyin ltar bskyed cing bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya/ de rjes bum pa/ gtor ma/ ga'u rnams kyang sngar ltar bskyed cing bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya/ de nas las thams cad pa'i bum par bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed la bsnyen pa brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ lha rnams la gtor ma phul la mnyes par byas te bdag 'jug 'og nas 'byung ba ltar blangs/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// gtso chen khyed la gsol 'debs kyi// ma lus bdag la bka' drin stsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slar yang*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i dam tshig rnams bsrung ba'i ched du mna' chu ni/ hoḥ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub 'thob// 'das na dmyal ba'i rgyu yin phyir// rdo rje dam tshig chu 'thung zhig /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes sbyin no// ye shes dbab pa ni| slob ma rnams nor lha gtso 'khor sngar ltar bskyed la/ slob dpon yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i nor lha gtso 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas slob ma la bstim/ bsnyen sngags mjug tu ā be sha ya a aḥ zhes dbab/ rdo rje rgya gram dang*/ tiṣṭha badzras brtan par bya/ de nas/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab la/ slob dpon gyis bum pa thogs nas/ hūm̐ */ bum pa rab yangs lus med skyed tshal du// 'phags pa nor lha'i chu 'dzin dra ba las// thugs rje'i zil mngar nor gyi phreng ba yis// dbul phongs mi bzad tsha rngam 'jig gyur cig /sngags mthar ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes spyi bor bskur zhing bum chu blud/ des nor bdag gtso 'khor lnga'i sku bsgom pa la dbang zhing phyi sgrub kyi dbang thob par brda sprad/ gtor ma spyi bor gtad la/ hūm̐ */ gtor ma mi zad dbul sel nam mkha'i mdzod// nor bdag rgyal ba'i nor bu dgos 'dod stsol// skal bzang mos pas gsol btab mnga' gsol tshe// 'dzad med nor gyi dngos grub thob gyur cig /rtsa sngags mjug tu ba ling a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes bskur/ des nang sgrub kyi phrin las la dbang zhing nor bdag gi dngos grub la dbang ba'i brda sprad/ sngags byang mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐ */ gsang sngags rgyal po yid bzhin nam mkha'i mdzod// dbul sel tsha zer lding khang stong phrag dbus// rab 'bar phrin las 'od zer nyer spros pas// phongs pa'i mun pa gting nas dengs byed shog /rtsa sngags mjug tu wā ka mant+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ

slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung ba zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i zhal dang rna bar zhugs pas slob ma nor bdag 'khor bcas su gsal ba'i gtso 'khor so so'i thugs kar zla ba nya gang ba'i steng du so so'i sa bon gyi mthar rang sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs nas/ bgrang phreng gtad la rtsa sngags kyi rjes zlos gsum byed la gzhug /slar slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// ces brjod/ slob dpon gyis/ nor bdag bcom ldan 'das ma dang*// gnod sbyin sde dpon 'khor dang bcas// skal ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes su pra tiṣṭha badzra me tog dang bcas pas brtan par bya/ des gsung gi snying po bzla ba la dbang zhing sngags kyi phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar brda sprad/ ga'u thogs nas/ hūm̐ */ dbul sel zla ba'i bu mo'i 'ching dbang sdud// nor bdag rin chen du ma'i dpal yon ni// dran pa tsam gyis dbul phong rab skem pa'i// nyes 'ching tsha ba'i gdung 'bar zhi gyur cig /rtsa sngags mjug tu bā su ka de ba ko ṣa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ des gsang sgrub zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gnad rnams bsgrub pa dang*/ thugs yang dag pa'i ye shes bsgrub pa la dbang bar brda sprad/ de nas skabs 'dir sngar bshad pa ltar chu sbyin rgyas par phul la/ chu sbyin gyi chu thigs pa re dang zas rnams slob ma la sbyin zhing*/ hūm̐ */ nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter 'chang nor rgyun ma// gnod sbyin mched bzhis bskor ba'i dbul sel lha// thugs rjes dpag yas 'gro rnams re ba skong*// yid la re ba'i 'bras bu mchis bar mdzod// rtsa sngags mjug tu sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ zhes sbyin/ slob mas bza' btung la longs spyad/ des yang gsang tsitta nam mkha'i rnal 'byor sgrub cing stong nyid snying rje tha mi dad du bsgrub pa la dbang bzhi nor bdag gtso 'khor gyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob pas/

'di nyid sgrub cing dbang bskur ba dang*/ phrin las kyi cho ga rnams la dbang ba yin zhing*/ 'di'i dus bza' btung gi tshogs gang 'dzoms pa rnams shugs 'byung du sgrub pa po la 'byung ba rten 'brel yin no// zhes brda sprad/ de ltar dbang bskur zhing lha 'di nyid kyi sgrub bsnyen bya ba'i dam tshig tu sngar gyi dam tshig rnams rgyas par bshad/ slob mas de nyid bsrung bar khas len pa'i ched du/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal dbul/ rjes chog ni/ mchod bstod sngar ltar byas la/ mchod gtor phul nas yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad gsos la/ sems can ser sna'i las kyi bud shing gis// sbar ba'i dbul phong byin zas gtses pa rnams// khyed kyi byams brtse'i bsil phreng dri gzhon gyis// gdung ba zhi zhing bde ba bskyed par mdzod| |ces dang sngar ltar 'dod don gsol ba btab/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ sogs dang*/ badzra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang nyid la thim par bsam/ rjes chog 'di dag chu sbyin la yang bya zhing*/ gtor sgrub kyi tshe gtor ma dngos grub tu rol nas gshegs gsol bya/ mdzod du sbas na lha gshegs gsol mi dgos/ ga'u dang yang gsang gi sgrub pa la gshegs bsdu bya mi dgos shing*/ 'di dag ni gnad phran bu ba kha shas bla ma'i gsung rgyun la ltos dgos shing lag len yang mthong rgyud ltar bya'o// ser sna'i las kyis gdung 'bar skye dgu rnams// nyer 'tshe zhi byed dbul sel gdams pa'i mdzod// dri gzhon ma rnying gsar pa 'di spel gyi// skal bzang 'dod pa sgrub byed nyid du mdzod// de ltar dbul sel nam mkha'i bang mdzod gter gyi snye ma zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ mdo stod zla kun dga' tshal gyi spyan snga gdan sa ba bzod pa phun tshogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi rgyud la brten nas gnod sbyin gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid rung mthun du sbyar nas nor rgyun ma la dzaṃ bha las bskor ba mo rgyud gtso bor bzung ba 'di'ang*/

dbur stod 'bri gung du skyes pa shākya'i dge slong rig pa lnga smra ba chos kyi grags pas chu phag gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum la mdo stod rngod kyi sa'i thig le bsam yul tshal du mgyogs par sbyar ba dag go// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
